title: Completed diagonal limit specification
statement: With the notation of [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface] and [def-sfb-diagonal-limit-interface], for $\ell$ prime, a scheme $Y$ on which $\ell$ is invertible and a simultaneous derived reduction $D$ of the strict coefficient tower on $W=\mathbf P^1_Y\times_Y\mathbf P^1_Y$, define the proposition that the integral Cartier boundary of the diagonal satisfies the simultaneous normalization predicate of [def-sfb-diagonal-limit-interface]: its strict reduction is a class $c$ in $\mathrm{Ext}^2$ from the reduced integral source to a tower $H$ whose underlying tower is identified with the roots-of-unity tower $(\mu_{\ell^{n+1}})_n$; the finite evaluations of $c$ are the torsion cycle classes [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data] with the Kummer normalization; and the completed arrow has source the supported completed constant normalized by the completed generator and target the completed Tate line [sk-def-sp-tate-twist] normalized by the root-limit comparison. This is a proposition, not its proof.
